title: Civic Inspection Lab
evidenceScope: A public-safe static explorer of the corrected v1.1 NYC inspection-triage simulator benchmark. Visitors can compare 24 evaluated policy, capacity, and access settings, then inspect one of five declared seed replays. It is not a live city system or a deployment recommendation.
